I fixed the cleartext error by adding a network security config that permits plain HTTP only for the emulator's host address, 10.0.2.2. I haven't built or run the app, since I can't here.

Changes:

1. **New file `app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml`**: allows `cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"` for the domain `10.0.2.2` only.
2. **`app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`**: added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to the `<application>` element.

I scoped it to 10.0.2.2 rather than allowing cleartext app-wide, so other plain-HTTP hosts stay blocked. If your catalog server runs on a different host or port, or you need cleartext elsewhere, add that domain to the config. Production builds should use HTTPS instead; you could also move this config into a debug-only resource set so it never ships in release builds.
